transcript: I have been loving all of the clips that they've been releasing of Sunset Boulevard at the Kennedy Center. Unlike the majority of my timeline right now, I'm not going to DC to go see it, and a little part of me does regret that decision. At the same time, I don't really love the show. Now, I will say I've never seen a production of it, and I would like to someday. And I feel like this probably would have ended up being a really good production to go see, but at the same time, I prioritized Secret Garden instead. But I will say I've listened to multiple cast recordings of it, and it's just. It's not my favorite score. The same problem that I personally have with a lot of Android Webber shows that are dramatic and song through, and that's that most of the songs just all blend together except for the title song. Like, I personally don't even really love Norma songs in the show, and I know that is controversial because those are classic show tunes, but my favorite song hands down is Sunset Boulevard, and I'm super happy that they released a clip of that because Derek Kleanna is fantastic. I have seen the movie and I adore the film. I think it is a classic film. If you've never seen it, definitely go watch it. And I love that people love Sunset Boulevard. I mean, there are huge, huge fans of this show. If you've never listened to The Sunset Project, this is an absolutely fantastic podcast by Tik tok's own Broadway Bob. And this entire podcast is such a beautiful journey. Not just of all the behind the scenes drama with the original production, but also bob's personal connection to the show and getting to hear him talk about the show and how much he personally connects to it. This is really what made me interested even going to see Sunset Boulevard at the Kennedy Center in the first place, and will definitely be the reason why one day I will actually go see this show. Ultimately, though, I put it in one of those shows where I would probably like it more if I saw a full stage production of it rather than a stage concert, which is what the Kennedy Center production is. I put it very much in the same vein of Phantom, where the score is just not for me. Though I do love the title song. But what really makes that show on Broadway is how fantastic the staging is. And so I feel the same way. If I saw a fantastically stage production of Sunset Boulevard, I too would probably really enjoy it.
